formation: Phonosemantic compound. 㯥 represents the sound and 曰 represents the meaning. Depicts a pair (㯥) of people speaking (曰) against each other, i.e. a plaintiff and a defendant. The meaning later expanded to "of the same generation".

components.note: The character 東 was originally a pictograph of a basket. This component is a pair of 東 merged together.
